bane_of_arthropods: Increases damage and applies Slowness IV to arthropod mobs (spiders, cave spiders, silverfish, endermites and bees).
breach: Reduces the effectiveness of armor points of attacked entities.
channeling: During thunderstorms, trident summons a lightning bolt on the target when hitting it.
binding_curse: Items cannot be removed from armor slots.
efficiency: Increases tool speed, as well as the chance for axes to disable shields.
fire_protection: Reduces fire damage and burn time.
flame: Arrows shot are ignited and deal fire damage to the target.
fortune: Increases the amount of block drops.
frost_walker: Allows the player to walk on water by freezing the water under their feet.
infinity: Prevents consumption of normal arrows (tipped arrows and spectral arrows are consumed).
luck_of_the_sea: Increases rate of good loot (enchanting books, etc.).
lunge: Increases speed of the player, allowing them to charge forward. Reduces durability quickly‌[
multishot: Fires 3 arrows at the same time.
piercing: Arrows pierce entities, allowing for arrows to pierce through stacks of mobs.
riptide: Trident launches player with itself when thrown while in water or rain.
soul_speed: Increases movement speed on soul sand and soul soil.
thorns: Taking damage causes the attacker to also take damage.
